title: Read reduction sequences
description: This parser records bottom-up reductions so the derivation appears in reverse construction order.

steps.description: The code defines the same productions, ACTION table, and GOTO table used by the LR parser.
parse maintains state and symbol stacks. On every reduce action, it records the right side and left side before replacing stack entries.
The loop parses two token sequences and prints each recorded reduction in order.

steps.question: Where does the subtree for 3 * 4 appear in the first reduction sequence?
steps.answer: The expected output identifies the reduction T * F -> T after both operand subtrees have already been reduced.

steps.description: The TODOs ask you to locate that multiplication subtree, alter the precedence table cell, and compare where precedence lives in recursive descent.
